summary_en: 900,000 shares to be cancelled. Post-cancellation issued share count: 6,736,368 shares. Effective 2026-09-15. Cancelled shares represent 11.8% of pre-cancellation issued total.
title_en: Notice regarding cancellation of treasury shares
translation_en_brief: KSK (code 9687, TSE Standard) announced via board resolution on 25 August 2026 that it will cancel 900,000 treasury shares of its own common stock, effective 15 September 2026, pursuant to Company Law article 178. The shares to be cancelled represent 11.8% of the pre-cancellation issued share count. Post-cancellation, the company's issued share count will decline from 7,636,368 shares to 6,736,368 shares. At the time of the board resolution, KSK held 1,564,348 treasury shares against a total issued base of 7,636,368 shares.
